title: Vendor CLI and API surface drift check against today's --help and today's schema
question_or_target: For every vendor command, flag and endpoint the program depends on (claude, codex, gh, git, uv, node, docker, wsl and each mounted MCP), does the invocation the code actually issues still exist and still mean the same thing today?
completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:ADV-0014 emitted ONLY when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, records BOTH named probes verbatim with their raw output, carries exactly one verdict from {CONFIRMED|REFUTED|PARTIAL|NOT-CHECKED|BLOCKED} per enumerated target, and records the result of every listed control/negative test.
